feasibility.high_roi_first_scope: Historical/educational reference to one verified edition's generic iris-map label or schematic sector,selected manually. No actual iris image or personal health input needed.
feasibility.deterministic_component: Source-defined left/right eye,viewer versus subject orientation,clock angle/radial bands and numbered legend lookup only after original diagram verification. Such geometry is documentary,not an anatomical or diagnostic correspondence.
feasibility.historical_component: Compare attributed chart terminology and source differences;describe discredited doctrine without assessing a person.
feasibility.access_gate: Neither ranked original atlas nor chart has been visually inspected or licensed here. Catalogs do not supply map rules. Bounded legitimate excerpt/rights verification required before implementing any lookup.
feasibility.empirical_boundary: Masked primary evaluation did not detect kidney disease above chance;review abstract does not support diagnostic validity. This does not deny that clinical ophthalmology can assess eye disease;no clinical eye tool proposed.
feasibility.avoid: No image upload,biometric processing,disease/susceptibility screening,organ health score,detox/treatment recommendation or personality/spiritual inference from iris appearance.
